## SCOTT J. DAVIDSON, PhD

|  |  |
|---|---|
| **Pronouns** | He/Him |
| **Email** | <davidson.scott_j@uqam.ca> |
| **Position** | Assistant Professor in Wetland Carbon Dynamics<br> Co-holder of the Quebec Research Chair on the study of **CAR**bon in wetlands as a nature-based solution to combat **CLI**mate change in **QUE**bec (**CARCLIQUE**) |
| **Other positions** | Adjunct Professor at La Trobe University, Australia |
| **Education** | University of Sheffield / San Diego State University, PhD<br> University of Sheffield, MSc<br> University of Dundee, MA (Hons) |
| **Social media** | [![](images/bluesky.svg){style="height:36px; width:auto; margin-right:18px; vertical-align:middle;"}](https://bsky.app/profile/wetlandresilienceresearchgroup.com) [![](images/linkedin.png){style="height:36px; width:auto; vertical-align:middle;"}](https://www.linkedin.com/in/scott-) |

:::
:::

My research is focused on the resilience of peatland and wetland ecosystems to both climate change and disturbance regimes. I combine field research, laboratory analysis, remote sensing and modelling approaches to better constrain spatio-temporal dynamics of wetland ecosystems.

I am a member of both the [GRIL-UQAM](https://gril.uqam.ca/) and [GEOTOP](https://www.geotop.ca/en) research centres.

I am currently the co-Chair of the British Ecological Society’s [Peatlands and Wetlands Special Interest Group](https://www.britishecologicalsociety.org/content/peatlands-and-wetlands-group/).

I am also a co-founder of both the [PEAT: Peatland ECR Action Team](https://peatecr.com/) and the [Wet Woodland Research Network](https://www.wetwoodlands.com/).
